exceptions.reason: Branch hygiene (allowlist, janitor workflow, release gate) is not installed in this repository yet; the release check would otherwise fail on this one rule and block every deploy. The install is a separate change.

local_gate: a="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rb-site-artifact-localgate"; node scripts/build/create-artifact.js --out "$a" && node scripts/qa/verify-artifact-integrity.js --artifact "$a" --expect-commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
